def find_player_middle(image):
    # Create an ImagePatch object
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    # Find all patches of the player in the image
    player_patches = image_patch.find("player")

    # If no player is found, return a message
    if not player_patches:
        return "No player found in the image."

    # Sort the patches by their distance to the center of the image
    player_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: math.sqrt((patch.left + patch.right) ** 2 + (patch.lower + patch.upper) ** 2))

    # Return the patch closest to the center
    return player_patches[0]

def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    person_patches = image_patch.find("person")
    tennis_racket_patches = image_patch.find("tennis racket")
    
    if not person_patches or not tennis_racket_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    person_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in person_patches]
    racket_centers = [(r.left + r.right) / 2 for r in tennis_racket_patches]
    
    closest_person = min(person_centers, key=lambda x: abs(x - max(racket_centers)))
    person_index = person_centers.index(closest_person)
    
    person_patch = person_patches[person_index]
    racket_patch = tennis_racket_patches[person_index]
    
    if person_patch.horizontal_center < racket_patch.horizontal_center:
        return person_patch
    else:
        return racket_patch
